'''Fallen Sky Lake''' {{co|66|82|Ashenvale}} is located in [[Ashenvale]] south of [[Silverwing Outpost]], west of the [[Warsong Labor Camp]], and northeast of [[Silverwing Grove]]. It is a small lake, and the island in the center in it holds a level 30 [[Shadethicket Oracle]] that you must kill for a quest. Surrounding the lake are other shadethickets of lower levels than the oracle.
